Hi Rachel,

Really appreciate the follow-up and the clear options. I wanted to flag up-front that we've had an internal roadmap reprioritization this week: leadership has asked teams to pause any new vendor pilots that are not tied to an immediate regulatory or revenue milestone.

On top of that, our CTO will be travelling in EMEA for most of June, so we won't have the cross-functional availability necessary to run a meaningful pilot until later in the year. Given that, we'd like to pause the demo planning for now.

Can you hold this conversation open and check back with us at the start of Q4? If you have a short one-pager showing what a minimal evaluation looks like (time, infra footprint, SLAs), please send it along and we'll save it for the next planning cycle.

Thanks for being flexible — we don't want to lose momentum entirely, just need to align with the new timeline.

Best,

Rachel — saw Liam's reply. A couple quick thoughts on options to keep the deal warm without burning credits: 

- Offer a lightweight tech brief (1-pager) and an on-demand recording of a pre-run demo they can watch — low lift.
- Offer to provision a read-only sandbox for 30 days (no custom data) so their architects can experiment asynchronously.
- Keep a calendar hold for late Sept and offer a single-week window check-in to confirm Q4 availability.

Also, depending on the contract discussion, we can offer a small one-time credit toward a pilot if leadership asks for a cost-offset when they re-prioritize (we've used this tact before).

Would you like me to draft the 1-pager and coordinate a short pre-record? If Diego can record a 12–15 minute walkthrough, that should be sufficient for Liam's team.
